vehicle: 2016 Ford Mustang 3.7 V6 (Cyclone Ti-VCT), PCM on HS-CAN 7E0/7E8
notes: Enhanced (Mode 22, ReadDataByIdentifier) data is manufacturer-specific and NOT standardised.
Every decode below is a community-cited CANDIDATE, unverified on this car. The tool always logs the raw bytes next to the decoded value, so a wrong formula can be fixed later from the same log.
Verify each value against a known reference before trusting it, then edit 'status'.
expr: A..Z are the data bytes after the DID; helpers S8(a) U16(a,b) S16(a,b) U24(a,b,c) U32(a,b,c,d).
Find more DIDs with:  py mustang_obd.py --bt --scan-dids quick   then add them here, or log all of them raw with --extra-dids <scan.csv>.
ECUs answering an unknown DID with requestOutOfRange are skipped automatically at start-up.
